title: Use of CPF Retirement Account Savings for Diploma and Degree Courses
what_it_is: Use of CPF Retirement Account Savings for Diploma and Degree Courses

sections.label: CPF Retirement Account and Education
sections.summary: At 55 an RA is created from OA and SA savings, and members may use OA savings for the CPF Education Scheme.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: When members turn 55, a Retirement Account (RA) is created and monies from the CPF OA and the Special Account (SA) are transferred to the RA up to the Full Retirement Sum.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: Members who own a property with sufficient charge or pledge on the property can withdraw their RA savings above the Basic Retirement Sum in cash for any purpose, including education.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: Members who continue to work and make CPF contributions after age 55 will also have fresh OA savings that can be used under the CPF Education Scheme.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: CPF members with insufficient OA savings should consider other avenues to finance the tertiary education of their children, for example, savings in the Post-Secondary Education Account (PSEA), student bursaries and loans offered by MOE and CDC/CCC, or the Tuition Fee Loan Scheme and Study Loan Scheme offered by the Government.

sections.label: RA Savings for Education Scheme
sections.summary: CPF Board allows RA savings originating from OA to be used for the CPF Education Scheme, though this compromises retirement adequacy.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: CPF Board has, therefore, exercised some flexibility by allowing them to use their savings in their RA that originated from their OA for the purpose of the CPF Education Scheme.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: However, CPF members must recognise that they are compromising on their retirement adequacy, especially if their children do not or are unable to repay the loan after graduation.

sections.label: Tuition Fee and Study Loans
sections.summary: The Tuition Fee Loan Scheme and Study Loan Scheme together can cover up to 100% of tuition fees.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: In response to the concerns expressed by the Member on what if the family is unable to secure sufficient loans to cover the tuition fees and so on, under the Tuition Fee Loan Scheme, diploma students can loan up to 75% and, for the remaining 25%, they can even apply for the Study Loan Scheme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: The Tuition Fee Loan Scheme, together with the Study Loan Scheme, will be able to cover up to 100% of the tuition fees.
